name: Ui Tennyo no Kemonomichi
source:
The celestial sisters, Nanori and Yuori, have come to a secluded hot spring deep in the mountains for a therapeutic soak.
A sinister monkey monster dwells in the hot spring.
As Nanori and Yuori shed their “Celestial Robes”—the source of their power—and expose their defenseless, naked bodies, the beast's lust, starved for a mate, pounces upon them.
